facts.fact: The APD says it fined MAXAM, Banco Comercial do Huambo and UNITEL for breaching personal data protection rules under Law 22/11, by deliberations 001-003/2024 of 30 April and 19 June 2024.
The Board of Directors of the Angolan Data Protection Agency issued fining deliberations under article 53(3) of Law 22/11.
Fines imposed on three entities under Law 22/11 of 17 June, cited by the APD as the basis of its deliberations.
